channel.description: Latest articles from The Southern Maryland Chronicle (southernmarylandchronicle.com)

item.title: Calvert County Unveils 2026 Guide to Beaches & More
item.description: Calvert County's 2026 Visitors Guide is out, packed with itineraries for beaches, museums like Calvert Marine, dining, events, and outdoor fun—download free at VisitCalvert.com/Brochure or request copies for your next Southern Maryland adventure.

item.title: Lusby Man, 71, Gets 25 Years for Child Sex Crimes
item.description: Ronald Truman Wathen, 71, of Lusby, sentenced to 25 years active prison time March 23, 2026, in Calvert County for second-degree rape and sex abuse of a child under 13, with no parole possible on minimum 15-year portion.

item.title: 14-Year-Old Driver Flees Police, Crashes Stolen Kia
item.description: Two juveniles, ages 14 and 15, in custody after crashing a stolen Kia Rio into a Maryland State Police vehicle during a pursuit in St. Mary's County early March 23, 2026; both treated at hospital following stop stick deployment on Route 5.

item.title: Dead for more than 3 million years, but megalodon still survives another day in the legislature
item.description: It only took 3.6 million years, but the giant prehistoric shark, megalodon, moved one step closer to becoming Maryland’s official state shark Monday. It took only slightly more than a month for the shark bill, House Bill 97, to move from committee hearing to House passage. It was one of a handful of commemorative bills that […]

item.title: Crossover day is here: Like your March Madness brackets, but for legislation
item.description: The budget is all but done. Important immigration legislation has already been signed into law, and high-profile energy reform legislation appears well on its way to passage. item.title: From Kindness to Leadership: Calvert's Lighthouse Honorees
item.description: Calvert County Public Schools names first Superintendent's Lighthouse Award honorees including Harmony Downs, Brooke Boteler, Channing Swanson, Renee Reid, Cheryl Dick and Willanette Thomas-Lohr for embodying district values through leadership, kindness and service.

item.title: 50-Pound Bundle of Joy: Maru Seeks Forever Home in Charles County
item.description: Meet Maru, a lively 1.5-year-old, 50-pound dog at Charles County Animal Care Center in Hughesville. This enthusiastic cheerleader offers constant encouragement, walks and snuggles. Available for adoption Monday-Friday 11am-4pm and Saturday 10am-3pm.

item.title: Special Consensus Brings 50th Anniversary Tour to Calvert Elks
item.description: Special Consensus, marking 50 years with two Grammy nominations, makes its Southern Maryland debut on April 19, 2026, at the Calvert Elks Lodge in Prince Frederick. Doors open noon, show at 2 p.m. Tickets $23. The sixth concert in the popular bluegrass series.

item.title: Carnival Vibes Hit La Plata as CSM Marks 40 Years of Youth Programs
item.description: The College of Southern Maryland hosts a free 40th Anniversary Bash for Kids and Teen College on Saturday, March 28, 2026, from 12-4 p.m. at La Plata Campus Parking Lot 3. Enjoy games, treats, program info and community summer camp details for ages 5-17. Rain location in ST Building Atrium.

item.title: Annapolis Paintball Incident Leads to Assault Charges Against Teen
item.description: Anne Arundel County Police arrested a 14-year-old on March 21, 2026, in Annapolis after he allegedly shot an adult male in the face with a paintball gun in the 600 block of Admiral Drive. The teen faces first-degree assault and reckless endangerment charges.
